summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Alterity Therapeutics Ltd, a foreign private issuer, for June 2026. The filing forwards a corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1) dated June 2026. No transaction, material definitive agreement, or special situation event is disclosed. The filing is purely a routine periodic update with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It merely furnishes a presentation and incorporates by reference into existing registration statements. As a routine 6-K that does not report any special-situation catalyst, the appropriate classification is None.
